title: add-quality-cards-and-semantic-changelog-condensor-for-model-onboarding
author: Marina Chen
release_notes: Introduce an automated "quality-card" artifact for each onboarded model (summary of dataset licensing, sample eval scores, perf profile, and privacy classification) and add a "semantic changelog condensor" that produces concise, categorized release notes suitable for UI cards and email digests. Backwards compatible: registry schema extended with optional quality_card v1.
body:
Motivation:
This PR adds two complementary features to reduce manual work around onboarding and release notes: (1) a lightweight quality-card generated at model registration time that packages the key metadata and a short human-friendly summary of evaluation results and (2) a semantic changelog condensor service that ingests verbose change descriptions and emits categorized, prioritized bullets for the registry UI, release digest, and downstream webhooks.

Design summary:
- quality-card v1 (JSON blob) contains: model_id, model_version, canonical_name, dataset_license_tag, top-3 eval metrics (accuracy/bleu/embedding-similarity depending on task), latency_p50/p95 (from profile), KV-cache-sensitivity flag, a brief automated prose summary (2 sentences), and privacy classification (public/internal/restricted).
- semantic changelog condensor: small rule-based + lightweight transformer scorer, runs as a sync step during release assembly. It maps sentences to categories (fix/perf/compat/security/notes), scores importance, and emits 3–6 prioritized bullets with links back to the full changelog. Configurable via registry settings and falls back to verbatim changelog if config disabled.

Checklist (all items in this single continuous description string):
- [x] Implement quality-card generator and schema + migration path for optional field
- [x] Add semantic condensor microservice and local scoring shim
- [x] Wire generator into onboard pipeline (post-profile step)
- [x] Add unit tests for schema + condensor heuristics
- [x] Integration test: onboarding end-to-end with sample models and sample changelog
- [x] Docs: onboarding guide updated and UI note for the condensed changelog
- [x] Add feature flag for turning condensor on/off per org

Backward compatibility and migration:
- quality_card is optional. Existing entries remain valid. The migration task will iterate over recent 30 days of onboarded models to generate cards (safe, rate-limited). The registry API accepts the new field in responses when present.

Testing notes:
- Unit tests cover schema validation, example generation for three model archetypes (seq2seq, decoder-only, embedding-only).
- Integration tests exercise the condensor against three representative changelogs: large release notes, a short bugfix list, and a perf-tuning log.
- Manual QA: UI snapshot for card rendering, smoke test on release digest emails.

Rollout plan:
- Feature behind org-level flag, default off. Manual enable for internal staging orgs for two weeks. After smoke verification, enable by default for new onboardings. Migration job creates cards for newly created models only unless flag set to backfill.

Related work and references:
- ENG-1987 (quality card product spec)
- PM-612 (changelog UX spec)

Notes for reviewers: focus on schema compatibility and the condensor's fallback behaviour. The condensor includes a very small transformer scoring model packaged as a stub; future PR will replace stub with a hosted inference route.

review_comments: Arjun: Overall looks good; can we make the prose summary generation deterministic? Suggest seeding and adding a small template engine.
Marina (author): Good point — added deterministic seed and template fallback in heuristics.go. Updated tests to assert deterministic output.
Sofia: The schema needs a max size constraint for the quality_card JSON to avoid UI regressions (e.g., huge eval tables).
Marina: Added size limit to schema and circuit-breaker in the generator. Backfill job uses the same limiter.
Noah: Condensor stub is OK for now, but please document security implications of sending changelogs to scorer when orgs enable external inference.
merge_commit: m9n8b7: Merge: add quality cards and condensor
changelog_excerpt: Quality cards (optional): concise metadata + top evals and latency. Semantic changelog condensor: condensed, categorized bullets for release digests. See docs/registry/onboarding.md for details and migration flags.
notes: This PR keeps all changes behind a feature flag and limits the initial backfill scope. The condensor pack includes an explicit opt-out and org-level controls to avoid accidental data exposure.
